patch_description: Replace the simple exponential weighted moving average with an adaptive two-pass filter combining (1) a fast Savitzky-Golay style local polynomial fit for zero-phase (forward-backward) smoothing that preserves slope/trend, (2) adaptive noise estimation via median absolute deviation to auto-tune smoothing strength, and (3) a robust trend-consistency step that suppresses spurious slope reversals. The key improvements: moving average introduces group delay ~W/2 causing high lag_error (0.38) and false reversals (175.4); a locally-fitted polynomial evaluated at the window center has near-zero phase delay and preserves polynomial trends exactly, dramatically improving lag_error, slope_changes, false_reversals, and correlation simultaneously. Computation is O(N*W) with vectorized numpy convolution for efficiency.
